notes.title: Playtest Signs Ups are Now Open!
notes.content:
Development on Long Drive North is progressing nicely as we head towards our Early Access launch later this year, and we can't wait to share more with you when it's ready!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/11458dd40a450e314a585af2e71b9caf4b50ee6b.jpg[/img]

[h1]We Need Your Help to Playtest Long Drive North![/h1]

[b]Playtest applications are now open, until 5pm BST/9am PDT on 28th April.[/b]

This playtest is limited to a very small number of players and we expect to receive many more applications than we can accept. We are planning multiple opportunities for the community to take part in playtesting before Early Access launch, so make sure to join the Discord to keep up-to-date on the latest news.

This is an exciting opportunity to have your say early on in development and help shape Long Drive North!

Join the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/RBhJdTWRRJ]Discord[/url][/b] and head to the #announcements channel for sign up instructions!

Thank you,
The Long Drive North team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/2b0954591a68c024b2fc22fde53886138c44b93e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Welcome to Long Drive North - Join the Discord Now
notes.content:
Hello, and welcome to Long Drive North!

We've been blown away by your support and enthusiasm for our game so far, and cannot wait to show you more in the lead up to our Early Access launch in 2025.

We'll be continuing to keep an eye on Steam forums, and will be sharing much more via Steam announcements like these, so make sure to wishlist and follow the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179350/Long_Drive_North_CoOp_RV_Simulator/

[h2]Join the Discord for Early Playtests![/h2]

You can also join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/RBhJdTWRRJ]Discord[/url][/b] to chat with fellow players, keep up to date with the latest news, and, in due course, gain access to early playtests to help us test the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/ee4070669cc833cf02f13e6ab26402b1e1c5e2f7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Join us on Social Media[/h2]

We're also keen to meet you where you are, so we've set up official social media accounts on [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61568128587459]Facebook[/url], [url=https://x.com/LongDriveNorth]X[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/longdrivenorthgame.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/longdrivenorth/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@longdrivenorth?lang=en]TikTok[/url][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/7f39fbd525c00a7b8198fe0718ff371d20669e33.jpg[/img]

We are super excited to have you along for the ride, and to share more about Long Drive North.

See you soon,
The Long Drive North Team
